allowed_causal_polymarket_inputs: market lifecycle and official resolution events
measurement_policy.onchain_order_filled_role: retrospective trade-side and fill audit only unless its observed confirmation delay is represented and the feature is available before the decision receipt
measurement_policy.public_last_trade_price_side_role: descriptive only; forbidden as authoritative signed order flow
measurement_policy.reason: public-feed trade direction has weak agreement with authoritative on-chain fills and can reverse effective-spread and price-impact signs
measurement_policy.signed_polymarket_flow_requires: authoritative OrderFilled semantics plus causal availability at the exact decision receipt
measurement_policy.unavailable_authoritative_flow_action: omit the feature; never infer or impute it

research_evidence.finding: A 30-billion-event Polymarket study reports only about 59% public-feed versus on-chain trade-direction agreement and sign instability in effective spread and Kyle lambda.
Official Polymarket documentation defines the on-chain OrderFilled event and its maker and taker asset semantics as the settled-trade record.

A synchronized 727-million-row BTC Polymarket-Binance study reports no out-of-sample edge after fees and slippage despite measurable quote response, reinforcing the book-prior and economic-gate requirements.

A 6.83-billion-event futures study finds statistically significant short-horizon predictability but no economic exploitability at taker costs, reinforcing the separation of accuracy from after-cost edge.
